name: documents-late
title: The documents are missing at the deadline: a reminder, then they arrive, and a person reads an illegible one
summary: Joaquim Ferreira applies and then forgets. After seven days the workflow sends a reminder and waits seven more; two days later the documents arrive. His proof of address is a photo the document service cannot read, twice, so the verification goes to Marco in customer care, who takes three hours: past the activity's service level, which is breached and recorded. The rest goes as planned.

output.notes: The proof of address is a photo too dark to read; the identity document and the mandate are in order.

agent.rationale: Two documents are in order; the proof of address cannot be read.

output.notes: Read again with contrast enhanced: the proof of address is still illegible. A person must check it.

agent.rationale: A second reading does not make the proof of address legible.

output.reasons: Joaquim asked for the variable plan. Without a smart meter, time of use is not available; at 2,400 kWh a year the variable plan is the cheapest today.

output.message: Welcome, Joaquim! Your supply at Flat 3, 22 Harbour Street starts on {{supply_start_date}} on our variable plan, with our low-carbon mix. Your first bill follows a month later, paid by direct debit. Thank you for sending your documents; we know the photo took a second try.

steps.say: Joaquim uploads his documents after the reminder
Marco, customer care, checks the proof of address with Joaquim by phone

output.notes: Called the customer: the tenancy agreement was sent again by e-mail and matches the supply address.

steps.say: Joaquim confirms the variable plan in the portal
The e-signature service reports the signed contract
The registry confirms the switch: the supply starts today
